planet.name: HELL
planet.summary: An underground ROCKtropia area with its own coordinates, reached free from any ROCKtropia teleporter. It has the Club HELL hub (storage, auction, trade and crafting terminals), Scott's Valley hunting domes with demons and legionaires (level 30 to 104), cursed mining caves and key-locked instances. Community events ran there throughout 2026.
planet.howToReach: Get to ROCKtropia. At any teleporter, choose HELL in the drop-down at the top right, then pick Club HELL Landing or another HELL teleporter. A February 2026 player report says this needs no Teleportation Tokens when you are on ROCKtropia or Secret Island. The first visit downloads extra area files.
warnings: Club HELL is a taxed area. A player at the October 2026 event got a 'left taxed area' message when entering the event zone. Mining caves are player-owned with 5% tax (older report).
Older guides say ROCKtropia Telemans Coins pay your passage in and out of Hell. 2026 player reports describe free drop-down travel. The coins are now mainly a crafting input for Hell Keys.

19.12.0 (2026-11-11) renamed 'Horny Little Devil' to 'Happy Little Devil' and stopped new hunting mission chains on ROCKtropia. The Hell kill-point missions (Hackathon, Little Devil) probably can no longer be started.
Some guides write Hell waypoints with 'Rocktropia' as the planet name. In-game and Nexus waypoints use 'HELL' or 'Hell'. Waypoints with the wrong area name may not work.

activities.title: Teleport to HELL and use Club HELL
activities.summary: Free teleporter jump from ROCKtropia to HELL. Club HELL Landing is the hub and revive point, with storage (separate for Hell), auction, trade terminal and crafting terminal.
steps: Stand at any ROCKtropia teleporter.
Choose HELL in the top-right drop-down and pick Club HELL Landing.
Let the extra area files download on the first visit.
rewards: Access to Hell hunting, mining and instances

cost.text: Free from ROCKtropia or Secret Island teleporters (February 2026 player report).

activities.limits: Hell storage is separate from ROCKtropia storage.

score.rationale: Free, instant, and opens all Hell content.

warnings: Club HELL is a taxed area.

activities.title: Hunt Scott's Valley domes (Little Devils and Legionaires)
activities.summary: Scott's Valley has two sides. East: level 30 Little Devils (renamed Happy Little Devil in 19.12.0), for low-mid players. West: Default Legionaires from level 60 to 104, said to suit solo or team mid-level hunters.
steps: Teleport to HELL and head to Scott's Valley (the community post shows the domes on a map image).
East side (NE/SE): Little Devils, level 30.
West side (NW/SW): Legionaires, level 60 to 104.
rewards: Loot and Codex progress for ROCKtropia creature groups

cost.text: Your own ammo, armor decay and healing.
cost.markupNote: A June 2026 review calls Hell economically weak.

locations.label: Scott's Valley domes, HELL (no waypoint in source; map image only)

score.rationale: Quick to reach and covers a wide level range. Costs scale with level.

activities.title: Monthly Global Competition in Scott's Valley (community)
activities.summary: A player-run monthly contest held through 2026. Hunt in Scott's Valley during the first three weeks of the month and post screenshots of your biggest Global or HoF. Prizes are donated by the organisers.
steps: Hunt in Scott's Valley from the 1st of the month (12:00 in-game time) for three weeks.
Screenshot every Global or HoF, showing your avatar, place and time.
Post the screenshots in the forum thread. Winners are posted in the fourth week and must make contact within 14 days.
rewards: Example (March 2026 round): 300 / 150 / 50 PED for the top three single loots, plus a 50 PED random draw among mining globals in the domes
requirementsText: Forum account or in-game contact with the organiser

cost.text: Normal hunting cost. Entry is free.

activities.limits: Prizes can change from month to month. Teams allowed with one entry per global.

cooldown.resetNote: New round each calendar month: three weeks of hunting from the 1st, then one week of prize handling.

score.rationale: Free extra chance at a prize while hunting. Not something to plan income around.

warnings: Player-run event. Latest round seen in the thread was March 2026. Check the thread before you count on it still running in late 2026.

activities.title: Halloween in HELL: Zombie-Kong's Revenge (seasonal)
activities.summary: A Halloween hunt run by the Church of Lootius together with MindArk on 31 October 2026 (and, per the organiser, also in 2025). MindArk spawns special mobs such as Zombie-Kong, Uber Vixens and Monkey-Zombies near Club HELL, followed by an afterparty at Club NEVERDIE.
steps: Around 31 October, check the Events forum for the year's thread.
Teleport to HELL and go to the event waypoint. You revive at Club HELL.
Bring proper armor. The mobs are large.
rewards: Event loot. The 2026 organiser said they could not see the loot pool.
requirementsText: Mid to high level gear advised

cost.text: Ammo, armor decay and healing for big mobs.

cooldown.resetNote: Yearly on Halloween. The 2026 event ran from 20:00 in-game time on 31 October until the last mob dropped.

locations.label: Halloween 2026 hunting area near Club HELL

score.rationale: Fun social event with big mobs. The cost depends on your gear.

warnings: Next run is not announced yet. The waypoint is from 2026.

activities.title: Demon Hackers: Source Code drops for Firewall gear and Hell Keys
activities.summary: Demon Hackers (level 27, about 1k HP, mostly electric damage) drop Open Source Code, used for Firewall armor, and Pure Source Code, used for higher Hell Keys. A player blog found little markup on these drops.
steps: Wear armor with good electric protection (Firewall sets are made for this).
Hunt Demon Hackers in Hell.
Sell the codes or keep them to craft Hell Keys.
rewards: Open Source Code and Pure Source Code

cost.text: Ammo, plus extra healing if your armor is weak to electric damage.
cost.markupNote: The blogger found Open Source Code had almost no markup or recent sales (undated, probably around 2022).

locations.label: Demon Hackers, HELL (no waypoint in source)

score.rationale: Mainly useful if you plan to craft Hell Keys.

warnings: Undated source, probably around 2022. Markup information may be stale.

activities.title: Hell Key instances (solo): Face your fears / enemies / allies / soul
activities.summary: Solo instances in Hell that use up a Hell Key on entry. Keys are crafted (Hell Key I to X blueprints, each using ROCKtropia Telemans Coins) or bought. A player blog called the boss too tough for mid-level gear and found keys hard to buy at a fair price.
steps: Craft or buy the right Hell Key (blueprint material cost runs from 4.2 PED for Key I to 40.2 PED for Key X).
Go to the instance entrance near Club HELL.
Enter solo. The key is used up.

cost.text: Key cost (crafting material value 4.2 to 40.2 PED by tier) plus ammo and decay.
cost.markupNote: Telemans Coins (2 PED TT) were offered in trade chat at 200-250% in 2025-2026.

currencies.name: ROCKtropia Telemans Coin
currencies.note: Crafting input for Hell Keys; old item text says it paid passage to Hell.

activities.limits: Solo only; one key per run.

locations.label: Face your fears entrance (source gives 39116, 21266 with planet name 'Rocktropia'; may need 'HELL' in game)

score.rationale: Expensive per run with unclear returns. Only for well-geared players.

warnings: No 2025-2026 run reports found. Which key tier opens which instance is not documented in the sources.

activities.title: Underground mining in the cursed caves
activities.summary: The central Hell caves are used for underground mining: half the search distance, but larger claims when you hit. They are player-owned with a 5% tax. ROCKtropia is a source of an ore used in D-Class mining amps.
steps: Teleport to HELL and enter the cursed caves in the middle area.
Drop finders as normal. Expect half the search range of surface mining.
Bring D-Class amps if you use amps; the blogger found few for sale locally.

cost.text: Probes, amps and decay. 5% land tax on claims.
cost.markupNote: Moving stackables off-planet through space carries loot risk; token travel has a 150 kg limit.

locations.label: Cursed caves, central HELL (no waypoint in source)

score.rationale: Niche mining spot with tax and a thin local market.

warnings: Blog is undated (probably around 2022). The 2026 contest thread mentions player-run 'mining events in Hell', so mining there still happens.

activities.title: Hell kill-point missions and skeleton ore missions (legacy)
activities.summary: Older guides list five kill-point missions near Club Hell Landing, such as Hackathon (Demon Hackers) and the Little Devil chain, plus ten ore missions from Thieves skeletons at Club Hell. Since 19.12.0 new ROCKtropia hunting chains cannot be started.
steps: If you already started a Hell hunting chain, finish it before about May 2027 (six-month window from 2026-11-11).
Take Duty Calls before The Great AI War. The AI War blocks Duty Calls.
Ore missions: Blausarium, Lysterium, Zinc, Belkar, Iron, Grunge, Nirvana, Mai Tai, Techno and Mojito (recorded at brokers only; no detail pages).
rewards: Hackathon: Laser Weapon Tech 10.2 PED (stage I), Rifle 20.40 PED (stage II)
Little Devil chain: Heavy Melee 51.88 PED (stage IV), Evade 33.07 PED (stage V)
requirementsText: Chain already started before 2026-11-11 (for hunting chains)
activities.limits: No new hunting chain starts since 19.12.0. Whether ore missions are affected is unknown.

score.rationale: Good skill rewards, but now mostly closed to new players.

warnings: Reward figures are old community data.

activities.title: Virus Kong waves via the Mindkey (reported)
activities.summary: The Company Issued Zombie Vaccine from ROCKtropia's The Cure can be traded to the Rogue Trader for a Mindkey. The Mindkey reportedly starts Virus Kong waves in Hell. This is end-game content for zombie-chain finishers.
steps: Finish The Cure on ROCKtropia for the vaccine.
Trade it for a Mindkey at the Rogue Trader (Chelsea building penthouse).
Use the Mindkey in Hell to start the waves.

cost.text: Gives up a tradeable vaccine, plus heavy ammo and decay.

warnings: The source itself says 'reportedly'. No recent confirmation found.
